ruleDefinitions.name: LSASS Process Memory Dump Creation Via Taskmgr.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of an "lsass.dmp" file by the taskmgr process. This indicates a manual dumping of the LSASS.exe process memory using Windows Task Manager.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\system32\\\\taskmgr\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\taskmgr\\\.exe$")) AND (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\lsass.*") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\.DMP.*")))
